sqlMap.select: SELECT DISTINCT KEY_1 AS APPR_ID FROM EAI.IF_APM_SEND WHERE BUYER IN (SELECT BUYER FROM IF_ADMIN WHERE BUYER_ID IN ('HWDF','HWDF3')) AND KEY_9 IS NULL AND KEY_1 IS NOT NULL AND CREATE_DATM > TRUNC(SYSDATE - 60) AND IF_FLAG = 'S'
sqlMap.update: UPDATE EAI.IF_APM_SEND SET KEY_8 = #RTN_MSG# , KEY_9 = #RTN_FLAG# , KEY_10 = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS') WHERE KEY_1 = #APPR_ID#
sqlMap.select:
SELECT DISTINCT B.COMPANY, B.DOCU_NO, B.PASS_STATUS, B.EXTIF_TP, B.EXTIF_NO, B.EXTIF_COUNT, B.CUR_ORDER_NO, C.USER_ID FROM EAI.IF_APM_SEND A , ICOGDOCU B , ICOGPASSLN C , ICOMLUSR D WHERE 1 = 1 AND A.KEY_1 = #APPR_ID# AND A.BUYER = B.COMPANY AND A.DOC_NO = B.DOCU_NO
AND D.COM_CODE = A.BUYER AND D.LEGACY_USER_ID = #APPR_SGID#
AND C.COMPANY = B.COMPANY AND C.DOCU_NO = B.DOCU_NO AND C.USER_ID = D.USER_ID
sqlMap.update: MERGE INTO HWIN_APPR_STATUS A USING ( SELECT #APPRID# AS APPRID FROM DUAL ) B ON ( 1 = 1 AND A.APPRID = B.APPRID ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET APPRSTATUSCD = #APPRSTATUSCD#, APPRTRANSSTATUSCD = #APPRTRANSSTATUSCD#, APPRKEY = #APPRKEY#, APPRREVNO = #APPRREVNO#, APPRSUBMITDT = #APPRSUBMITDT#, APPRCONFIRMDT = #APPRCONFIRMDT#, INSERTUID = #INSERTUID#, INSERTDT = #INSERTDT#, UPDATEUID = #UPDATEUID#, UPDATEDT = #UPDATEDT#, ERRORDETAIL = #ERRORDETAIL# WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( APPRID, APPRSTATUSCD, APPRTRANSSTATUSCD, APPRKEY, APPRREVNO, APPRSUBMITDT, APPRCONFIRMDT, INSERTUID, INSERTDT, UPDATEUID, UPDATEDT, ERRORDETAIL ) VALUES ( #APPRID#, #APPRSTATUSCD#, #APPRTRANSSTATUSCD#, #APPRKEY#, #APPRREVNO#, #APPRSUBMITDT#, #APPRCONFIRMDT#, #INSERTUID#, #INSERTDT#, #UPDATEUID#, #UPDATEDT#, #ERRORDETAIL# )
